rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a computer or system becoming unresponsive.

example.english: The computer has gone into a hang and isn't responding.
example.traditional: 部電腦死機喇，撳乜都冇反應。
example.jyutping: bou6 din6 nou5 sei2 gei1 laa3 gam6 mat1 dou1 mou5 faan2 jing3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something being suspended or for putting something up by hanging it.

example.english: I hang the picture on the wall.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zoeng1 fuk1 waa2 gwaa3 hai2 coeng4 soeng6

rows.note: Use this for a computer or program that stops responding, or for causing it to freeze.

example.english: My computer can hang when I open too many programs.
example.traditional: 我部電腦一開太多程式就死機。
example.jyutping: ngo5 bou6 din6 nou5 jat1 hoi1 taai3 do1 cing4 sik1 zau6 sei2 gei1

rows.note: Use this specifically for killing someone by hanging or for someone being hanged to death.

example.english: They decided to hang the prisoner.
example.traditional: 佢哋決定吊死嗰個犯人。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 kyut3 ding6 diu3 sei2 go2 go3 faan6 jan4

rows.note: Use this when someone lingers or loiters idly instead of leaving.

example.english: We often hang around by the waterfront after dinner.
example.traditional: 我哋食完飯成日仲喺海旁流連。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 sik6 jyun4 faan6 sing4 jat6 zung6 hai2 hoi2 pong4 lau4 lin4
